firstPlayerRule: Randomly line up the Traveler pieces at the starting inn in Kyoto. The Traveler farthest behind on the route moves first.
clarifications: The Traveler farthest behind takes each turn; a player can therefore take consecutive turns.
With two players, add a neutral Traveler to the random starting lineup. When that Traveler is last, the player whose own Traveler is in front moves it.
Choose Traveler tiles before determining the starting order.
